description:
THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION. The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Benefits Administration (VBA) is issuing this Sources Sought for Document Destruction Services for Human Capital Services (HCS).
The intent is to locate Certified SDVOSB or VOSB contractors capable of providing Document Destruction services at the sites listed below through a single contract award.   The information provided may be used by VBA in developing its acquisition strategy.

Location

This notice is issued solely for information and planning purposes only. There is no obligation for the Government to acquire any products or services described in this notice. Responses to this notice are not quotes and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract.  
Interested parties are responsible for adequately marking proprietary, restricted or competition sensitive information contained in their response. Only electronic responses to this notice will be accepted. The Government will not pay for any time expended or information submitted in response to this notice. Eligibility in participating in a future acquisition does not depend upon a response to this notice.
Please submit responses via email to the Contracting Officer, Bridget Bartolomei, bridget.bartolomei@va.gov, by the due date and time listed above.
Your company name, address, contact person name, phone number, fax number, e-mail address(s) and SAM Unique Entity ID and company website if available. 

Your company s GSA/FSS contract number if available. 

Socio-economic status of business SDVOSB/VOSB.
